text: Will the heater keep the whole basin clear?

author: agent
text: Both heaters are rated for this basin. The immersion heater warms the water directly, while the cable warms it through the sides. Either keeps the water clear through an ordinary winter here. We should check the power connection before fitting one, and leave the cable out of reach of the birds. The immersion heater is also easier to remove when we scrub the basin. The cable stays wrapped around it, so we would need to keep that clear of the cleaning brush. Check the instructions for the heater we pick before connecting it, then test it on a cold morning before relying on it through the winter.
